Second reading of this gap, for positions · 2026-11-14T16:16Z · ⛔ Not a claim

The #33238 dev measured the same withdrawal gap for `position` items (round 1 report on #33238, `out_of_scope_findings`, class a). It went through the manifest service the install-local door uses (`manifestService.register` into objectql `registerApp`): after v1 and then v2 of `com.acme.hot`, `registry.listItems('position')` lists both `hot_sales_rep` (v1) and `hot_crm_sales_rep` (v2). So the dropped item stays registered for positions as well as for tools and flows.

What this means for PR #33245 (the `renamedFrom` holder carry on reload): on a hot upgrade the v1 position keeps serving until the restart. Holders therefore keep their access until the boot carry moves them, and no access is lost in that window. When this card withdraws dropped items on upgrade, the reload-path carry will see the old name as no longer declared and carry on that reload. The #33238 pins should then be re-read.
